name: Perplexity
knownFor: A dedicated AI answer engine that searches the web and cites sources in the reply.
popCaption: 0.8% of visits to seven tracked AI assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates; website visits only). That set also includes general chatbots, so this is a small but cited standalone-site share · checked Nov 2026
pro: A dedicated answer engine, not only a chatbot with a search toggle
con: Official Pro price was not captured this session; website-visit share is small
costCaption: Perplexity sells a Pro (or equivalent) individual plan, but perplexity.ai/pro was not readable this session (the request was blocked). Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual Pro plan. Confirm current prices on perplexity.ai. A free tier exists.

name: Google AI Mode
knownFor: AI answers inside Google Search (AI Mode / AI Overviews and related Gemini features in Search).
popCaption: Editorial estimate based on Google Search’s distribution, not on the Similarweb chatbot-site table (those visits are for gemini.google.com, not Search itself) · checked Nov 2026
learn: AI answers where you already search
pro: Sits inside Google Search, which no standalone answer engine can match for distribution
con: Not a separate product site, so there is no clean visit-share figure just for AI Mode
costCaption: AI Mode lives inside Google Search. Higher limits and features are described on Google AI plans: Plus $4.99/month and Pro $19.99/month (one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans, checked Nov 2026), including more access to image features in Search. Rated on Plus, the cheapest individual paid plan that advertises more Search AI access. Core Search remains free.

name: ChatGPT Search
knownFor: Web search inside ChatGPT, with cited results in the same thread as a normal chat.
popCaption: Tied to ChatGPT’s 55.7% share of seven-assistant website visits in October 2026 (Similarweb). This is not a search-only traffic figure · checked Nov 2026
pro: Search where many people already chat
con: Not a dedicated answer engine; quality and limits follow the ChatGPT plan
costCaption: Included with ChatGPT. Rated on ChatGPT Plus at $20/month (OpenAI Help, checked Nov 2026). Search availability and limits can differ on Free, Go, Plus, and Pro — confirm on chatgpt.com.

name: Microsoft Copilot (search)
knownFor: Copilot’s web-and-Bing search answers, on the Copilot site and inside Microsoft 365 and Windows.
popCaption: Copilot’s standalone site had 1.1% of seven-assistant website visits in October 2026 (Similarweb). In-product search in Bing, Windows, and Edge is not in that figure · checked Nov 2026
learn: Search in Bing, Windows, or Microsoft 365
pro: Built into Microsoft’s browser and office surfaces
con: Standalone-site traffic looks small next to in-product use
costCaption: Rated on Microsoft 365 Premium at $19.99/month (microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/pricing/individuals, checked Nov 2026) when used as the paid consumer bundle. A free Copilot experience also exists on the web and in Bing.

name: Grok (search)
knownFor: Grok’s live web and 𝕏 search, sold through the X Subscription.
popCaption: Grok had 2.2% of seven-assistant website visits in October 2026 (Similarweb). That is the whole Grok site, not search alone · checked Nov 2026
learn: Live web and 𝕏 search in one assistant
pro: Real-time 𝕏 integration that other answer engines do not have
costCaption: Included with the X Subscription. Rated on Premium at $30/month, marked most popular on x.ai/pricing (checked Nov 2026). Plus at $8/month also includes Grok features. A free tier is listed.

name: You.com
knownFor: An AI search engine and assistant with modes for search, research, and apps.
pro: A dedicated search product, not only a chatbot mode
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: You.com sells a Pro (or equivalent) individual plan. This session did not capture a current official monthly figure. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on you.com.

name: Phind
knownFor: An AI search tool aimed at developers, with answers grounded in technical sources.
pro: Aimed at developers rather than general web Q&A
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Phind sells a Pro plan. This session did not capture a current official monthly figure. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on phind.com.

name: Exa
knownFor: A web-search API and research product aimed at developers and agents that need to retrieve from the web.
learn: Search as an API for apps and agents
pro: Built for retrieval, not a consumer chat box
con: Usage-based pricing; the cost band is an editorial estimate
costCaption: Exa is primarily usage-based API pricing, with paid product plans. This session did not capture a current official individual monthly seat. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical light individual API spend — no total was invented. Confirm current prices on exa.ai.

name: Brave Search / Leo
knownFor: Brave’s independent search engine, plus the Leo assistant that can answer from search results in the Brave browser.
learn: Private-ish search with a built-in assistant
pro: Search and the assistant live in the same independent browser
con: Official Leo price was not captured this session
costCaption: Brave Search is free to use. Leo has a free tier and a paid Leo Premium (or equivalent) plan. This session did not capture a current official monthly figure. Editorial estimate $ for a typical individual Leo paid plan. Confirm current prices on brave.com/leo.
